Added today PROPERTY TYPE Semi-Detached BEDROOMS 4 BATHROOMS 2 SIZE Ask agent TENURE Freehold 1 +25 Key features Luxury BathroomModernNo Onward ChainQuiet Residential RoadSemi-Detached HouseDrivewayGas Central HeatingHigh CeilingsMulti-use outbuildingPeriod Features Description Set on an attractive residential street in the heart of Wimbledon, this beautifully presented four-bedroom semi-detached period home offers an exceptional balance of character, space, and modern family living, thoughtfully arranged across three floors. The ground floor immediately impresses with a generous bay-fronted reception room, rich in period charm. To the rear, the property opens into a stunning open-plan double reception and fully fitted kitchen, creating a superb social space with excellent natural light and a seamless connection to the garden. A guest WC completes this level, adding practicality for everyday living. The private rear garden features a decked area perfect for entertaining. At the far end, an outbuilding with electrics provides a highly versatile space, ideally suited as a home office, gym, or studio. On the first floor, two well-proportioned double bedrooms are complemented by a beautifully appointed family bathroom, complete with a classic roll-top bath and separate shower cubicle. The top floor offers two further generous double bedrooms along with an additional bathroom, making it an ideal layout for growing families or those requiring flexible accommodation. The location is particularly sought-after, offering easy access to the vibrant amenities of Wimbledon Town Centre, with its wide selection of shops, restaurants, and cafés. Excellent transport links are available from Wimbledon Station, providing District Line Underground services, mainline connections to London Waterloo, and Tramlink services, ensuring swift and convenient access into Central London and beyond. The area is also well regarded for its selection of outstanding schools, both state and private, further enhancing its appeal for families.
